title: CAT(0) spaces quasi-isometric to Euclidean spaces
summary: We show that if a proper, geodesically complete, CAT(0) homology manifold is quasi-isometric to the Euclidean space R^n then it is homeomorphic to R^n. On the other hand, we show that there exist proper, geodesically complete, CAT(0) spaces quasi-isometric to R^n, which are not homeomorphic to it. We prove that our example is sharp in a suitable sense.
